text:
The current meeting accepts shareholder votes on the resolutions.

A certificate confirming the holding is expressly not required for this vote.
A prohibition on splitting votes between opposing directions is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Delivery of a power-of-attorney instrument is expressly not required for this vote.
Advance registration for voting is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Recall of securities on loan before voting is expressly not required for this vote.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
A minimum holding of 500 shares to exercise voting rights is mandatory for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Blocking of the voted securities is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
